name: Kasa Smart Light Bulb Multicolor KL125 (US)

radios.note: 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi (802.11 b/g/n) per the datasheet; the bulb joins the home network directly.

matter.note: Neither the Kasa product page nor the KL125 datasheet mentions Matter, and we found no CSA listing for the KL125.

apple_home.note: Kasa lists Alexa, Google Assistant and SmartThings for this bulb, and a TP-Link community guide to Apple Home lists no Kasa lights. No source states 'not supported' outright, and Matter status is unconfirmed.

google_home.note: Works with Google Assistant through the Kasa cloud integration.

alexa.note: Works with Alexa through the Kasa skill.

smartthings.note: Kasa lists SmartThings as a supported voice/smart-home platform for the KL125.

home_assistant.note: The official TP-Link Smart Home integration lists the KL125 among supported bulbs. It notes no light effects on Kasa bulbs.

hubRequired.note: For bulbs, this means needing a bridge or hub for basic app control. The KL125 connects straight to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi and is controlled from the Kasa app.

localControl.note: Home Assistant's integration talks to Kasa devices on the LAN without the TP-Link cloud (local polling). Newer firmware may need TP-Link cloud credentials once to authenticate.

colorType.note: Full colour plus tunable white from 2500 to 6500 K.

summary: The Kasa KL125 is a US A19 colour bulb with an E26 base, rated at 800 lumens and tunable from 2500 to 6500 K. It connects directly to 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi, so no hub is needed. Kasa lists Alexa, Google Assistant and SmartThings, and Home Assistant supports it through the official TP-Link integration.
caveats: Needs a 2.4 GHz Wi-Fi network; 5 GHz is not supported.
No Apple Home support is listed for this bulb.
